name: fespalier
description: Shows fespalier route-tree errors and warnings in the Problems panel, runs fsp gen, runs the tasks of fespalier: tasks: from Run Task, and completes and checks the fespalier: section of pubspec.yaml (with the YAML extension).

enumDescriptions: Use fsp when it is on PATH, otherwise dart run fespalier.
Always run dart run fespalier (the package downloads the matching fsp).
fespalier.runner.description: How to run the fespalier generator.

fespalier.fspPath.description: The fsp executable to run (a name on PATH, or a full path).

fespalier.checkOnSave.description: Run fsp check when a file under the app folder (fespalier: app_dir in pubspec.yaml, lib/app by default) or a Dart file under lib/ is saved.

task.description: A task of `fespalier: tasks:` in pubspec.yaml. `dev` runs `fsp dev`, `build` runs `fsp build <target>`, any other name `fsp run <name>`.

path.description: The folder with the pubspec.yaml, relative to the workspace folder. Leave it out for the workspace folder itself.

target.description: For `build` only: what `flutter build` builds (apk, appbundle, ios, ipa, web, macos, linux, windows, ...).

args.description: Passed on after `--`: to `flutter run` for `dev`, to `flutter build <target>` for `build`, to the task's `run` command otherwise.
